title: Amazon Orders Engineers to Stop Gaming AI Metrics to Appear More Productive
summary:
A new internal memo directs Amazon's engineering teams to end the practice of inflating their AI statistics to meet company adoption goals. The company has officially forbidden employees from "tokenmaxxing," a behavior where staff run artificial intelligence on useless tasks to maintain high scores in internal tracking systems that measure how often technical teams use AI tools.

While Amazon acknowledges that evaluating productivity solely by the volume of tokens consumed is "deeply flawed," it stated that these usage metrics will remain in use because they correlate with overall results. Management intends to use the data specifically to monitor the 10th percentile of teams with the lowest AI adoption rates to ensure the technology is being implemented effectively.
